note: Manual owner overrides for rosters that changed hands mid-season. Sleeper only records a roster's final owner, so games in the listed weeks are credited to the listed manager id instead.

overrides.reason: Mike Dewey ran this roster Weeks 1-7 of 2024. He left after the league overturned his trade with Matt Froemming, and Matt Z (the roster's Sleeper owner) took it over from Week 8.
evidence: Sleeper 2024 transactions: every roster-2 move through Mon 2024-10-21 was made by Mike Dewey's account, including the 2024-10-19 trade with roster 8 (Matt Froemming) that the commissioner reversed on 2024-10-20. Matt Z's first move was a Week 8 waiver claim on Tue 2024-10-22.
